Name: HuntHop
Author: Kat
Punchline: Faloop spawn alerts in chat, with a one-click world visit through Lifestream.
Description: Receives Faloop spawn alerts from a browser userscript over localhost, posts them to chat with a [Go] link, and can world-visit through Lifestream when you are idle at a city aetheryte. Requires Lifestream.
